001package com.streamConverter.command.impl.csv;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamConverter.path.CSVPath;
005import java.io.BufferedReader;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.InputStreamReader;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.io.OutputStreamWriter;
011import java.io.Writer;
012import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Arrays;
015import java.util.List;
016import java.util.stream.Collectors;
017
018/**
019 * CSV Filter Command Class
020 *
021 * <p>This class implements pure data extraction from CSV using column selectors. Unlike
022 * CsvNavigateCommand which applies transformations, CsvFilterCommand only extracts/filters columns
023 * based on specified column names or indices without any modifications.
024 *
025 * <p>Features: - Extract specific columns using column names or indices - Preserve exact data
026 * values from extracted columns - Memory-efficient streaming processing - Support for multiple
027 * column selection
028 */
029public class CsvFilterCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
030
031  private final CSVPath combinedSelector;
032  private final boolean hasHeader;
033
034  /**
035   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single column selector.
036   *
037   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to extract (e.g., "name", "2")
038   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
039   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null or empty
040   * @deprecated Use {@link #CsvFilterCommand(CSVPath, boolean)} instead
041   */
042  @Deprecated
043  public CsvFilterCommand(String columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
044    if (columnSelector == null || columnSelector.trim().isEmpty()) {
045      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null or empty");
046    }
047    this.combinedSelector = new CSVPath(columnSelector.trim());
048    Arrays.asList(columnSelector.trim());
049    Arrays.asList(this.combinedSelector);
050    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
051  }
052
053  /**
054   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single typed column selector.
055   *
056   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to extract
057   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
058   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelector is null
059   */
060  public CsvFilterCommand(CSVPath columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
061    if (columnSelector == null) {
062      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selector cannot be null");
063    }
064    this.combinedSelector = columnSelector;
065    Arrays.asList(columnSelector);
066    Arrays.asList(columnSelector.toString());
067    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
068  }
069
070  /**
071   * Constructor for CSV filtering with multiple column selectors.
072   *
073   * @param columnSelectors list of column names or indices to extract
074   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
075   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelectors is null or empty
076   * @deprecated Use {@link #CsvFilterCommand(List, boolean)} with CSVPath list instead
077   */
078  @Deprecated
079  public CsvFilterCommand(List<String> columnSelectors, boolean hasHeader) {
080    if (columnSelectors == null || columnSelectors.isEmpty()) {
081      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selectors cannot be null or empty");
082    }
083    this.combinedSelector = new CSVPath(columnSelectors); // Use multi-selector constructor
084    new ArrayList<>(columnSelectors);
085    columnSelectors.stream().map(CSVPath::new).collect(Collectors.toList());
086    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Private constructor for internal use with typed column selectors.
091   *
092   * @param columnSelectors list of typed CSVPaths to extract
093   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
094   * @param internal marker parameter to distinguish from deprecated constructor
095   */
096  private CsvFilterCommand(List<CSVPath> columnSelectors, boolean hasHeader, boolean internal) {
097    if (columnSelectors == null || columnSelectors.isEmpty()) {
098      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Column selectors cannot be null or empty");
099    }
100    // Combine multiple CSVPath objects into one with multiple selectors
101    List<String> selectorStrings =
102        columnSelectors.stream().map(CSVPath::toString).collect(Collectors.toList());
103    this.combinedSelector = new CSVPath(selectorStrings);
104    new ArrayList<>(columnSelectors);
105    this.hasHeader = hasHeader;
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * Factory method for CSV filtering with multiple typed column selectors.
110   *
111   * @param columnSelectors list of typed CSVPaths to extract
112   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
113   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
114   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if columnSelectors is null or empty
115   */
116  public static CsvFilterCommand create(List<CSVPath> columnSelectors, boolean hasHeader) {
117    return new CsvFilterCommand(columnSelectors, hasHeader, true);
118  }
119
120  /**
121   * Constructor for CSV filtering with single column selector (assumes header exists).
122   *
123   * @param columnSelector the column name or index to extract
124   * @deprecated Use {@link #create(CSVPath)} instead
125   */
126  @Deprecated
127  public CsvFilterCommand(String columnSelector) {
128    this(columnSelector, true);
129  }
130
131  /**
132   * Factory method for CSV filtering with single typed column selector (assumes header exists).
133   *
134   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to extract
135   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
136   */
137  public static CsvFilterCommand create(CSVPath columnSelector) {
138    return create(columnSelector, true);
139  }
140
141  /**
142   * Factory method for CSV filtering with single typed column selector.
143   *
144   * @param columnSelector the typed CSVPath to extract
145   * @param hasHeader whether the CSV has a header row
146   * @return a CsvFilterCommand instance
147   */
148  public static CsvFilterCommand create(CSVPath columnSelector, boolean hasHeader) {
149    return create(Arrays.asList(columnSelector), hasHeader);
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Constructor for CSV filtering with multiple column selectors (assumes header exists).
154   *
155   * @param columnSelectors list of column names or indices to extract
156   * @deprecated Use constructor with List&lt;CSVPath&gt; instead
157   */
158  @Deprecated
159  public CsvFilterCommand(List<String> columnSelectors) {
160    this(columnSelectors, true);
161  }
162
163  @Override
164  protected String getCommandDetails() {
165    return String.format(
166        "CsvFilterCommand(columns=%s, hasHeader=%s)", combinedSelector.toString(), hasHeader);
167  }
168
169  @Override
170  protected void executeInternal(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
171      throws IOException {
172    try (BufferedReader reader =
173            new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(inputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
174        Writer writer = new OutputStreamWriter(outputStream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) {
175
176      List<Integer> columnIndices = new ArrayList<>();
177      String[] headers = null;
178
179      // Read first line
180      String firstLine = reader.readLine();
181      if (firstLine == null) {
182        // Empty CSV
183        writer.flush();
184        return;
185      }
186
187      String[] firstRowFields = parseCsvLine(firstLine);
188
189      if (hasHeader) {
190        headers = firstRowFields;
191        // Map column selectors to indices
192        columnIndices = mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(combinedSelector, headers);
193
194        // Write filtered header
195        writeFilteredRow(writer, firstRowFields, columnIndices);
196        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
197      } else {
198        // No header - column selectors must be numeric indices
199        columnIndices = parseNumericColumnSelectors(combinedSelector, firstRowFields.length);
200
201        // Write filtered first data row
202        writeFilteredRow(writer, firstRowFields, columnIndices);
203        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
204      }
205
206      // Process remaining data rows
207      String line;
208      while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
209        String[] fields = parseCsvLine(line);
210        writeFilteredRow(writer, fields, columnIndices);
211        writer.write(System.lineSeparator());
212      }
213
214      writer.flush();
215    }
216  }
217
218  /**
219   * Map column selectors to column indices using Don't Ask Tell pattern
220   *
221   * @param csvPath the CSV path containing multiple selectors
222   * @param headers array of header names
223   * @return list of column indices
224   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if no columns found
225   */
226  private List<Integer> mapColumnSelectorsToIndices(CSVPath csvPath, String[] headers) {
227    List<Integer> indices = csvPath.findMatchingIndices(headers);
228    if (indices.isEmpty()) {
229      throw new IllegalArgumentException("No columns found for selector: " + csvPath.toString());
230    }
231    return indices;
232  }
233
234  /**
235   * Parse numeric column selectors when no header exists using Don't Ask Tell pattern
236   *
237   * @param csvPath the CSV path containing column selectors
238   * @param totalColumns total number of columns available
239   * @return list of column indices
240   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if no valid indices found
241   */
242  private List<Integer> parseNumericColumnSelectors(CSVPath csvPath, int totalColumns) {
243    List<Integer> indices = csvPath.findMatchingIndices(totalColumns);
244    if (indices.isEmpty()) {
245      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
246          "Column selector must be numeric when no header: " + csvPath.toString());
247    }
248    return indices;
249  }
250
251  /**
252   * Parse a CSV line into fields (simple implementation)
253   *
254   * @param line CSV line
255   * @return array of field values
256   */
257  private String[] parseCsvLine(String line) {
258    // Simple CSV parsing - handles basic comma separation
259    // For production, consider using a proper CSV library
260    if (line == null || line.isEmpty()) {
261      return new String[0];
262    }
263
264    List<String> fields = new ArrayList<>();
265    StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
266    boolean inQuotes = false;
267
268    for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
269      char c = line.charAt(i);
270
271      if (c == '"') {
272        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
273      } else if (c == ',' && !inQuotes) {
274        fields.add(current.toString().trim());
275        current.setLength(0);
276      } else {
277        current.append(c);
278      }
279    }
280
281    fields.add(current.toString().trim());
282    return fields.toArray(new String[0]);
283  }
284
285  /**
286   * Write filtered row with only selected columns
287   *
288   * @param writer output writer
289   * @param fields all field values
290   * @param columnIndices indices of columns to include
291   * @throws IOException if writing fails
292   */
293  private void writeFilteredRow(Writer writer, String[] fields, List<Integer> columnIndices)
294      throws IOException {
295    for (int i = 0; i < columnIndices.size(); i++) {
296      if (i > 0) {
297        writer.write(",");
298      }
299
300      int columnIndex = columnIndices.get(i);
301      if (columnIndex < fields.length) {
302        String field = fields[columnIndex];
303        // Quote field if it contains comma or quotes
304        if (field.contains(",") || field.contains("\"")) {
305          writer.write("\"" + field.replace("\"", "\"\"") + "\"");
306        } else {
307          writer.write(field);
308        }
309      } else {
310        // Column doesn't exist in this row - write empty field
311        writer.write("");
312      }
313    }
314  }
315}
